        self.window.setTitle_(dialog.title)
        self.usernameField.setStringValue_(dialog.prefillUser or "")
        self.passwordField.setStringValue_(dialog.prefillPassword or "")
        self.textArea.setStringValue_(dialog.description)
        self.result = None
        return self
